la_school_immunization.name: Louisiana School Immunization Coverage
la_school_immunization.description: Parish-level coverage and exemption data from a multi-year Louisiana Office of Public Health school immunization workbook, covering kindergarten, 6th, and 11th grade. The workbook reports a different antigen panel per grade: kindergarten gets DTaP/TD (>=4 doses) and Polio (>=3); 6th and 11th grade get Tdap (>=1) and MenACWY (>=1 for 6th, >=2 for 11th, merged here into rate_mcv4); all three grades get HepB, HepA, MMR, and Varicella (HepA and MMR are populated for only some years). "Complete Records", the source's overall up-to-date share, is carried over as rate_complete.
la_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data. Ingested from a committed multi-year parish workbook because the LDH online dashboard is behind authentication.
